origin.description: Valid completions after the ``@`` extractor are generated by ``.AtNames``. For an S4 object it matches ``pattern`` against slot names via ``findMatches``; otherwise it returns an empty character vector.

arguments.name: x
arguments.description: The object after ``@`` in the partial command line.

origin.details: Completion after extractors ``$`` and ``@`` is controlled by the ``ops`` setting in ``rc.settings``. ``findMatches`` filters ``values`` with exact or fuzzy matching depending on completion options.
origin.value: A character vector of matching slot names, or ``character()`` when ``x`` is not S4.
origin.example:
library(utils)
methods::setClass("TestS4AtNames", slots = c(a = "numeric", b = "character"))
obj <- methods::new("TestS4AtNames", a = 1, b = "x")
paste(.AtNames(obj, ""), collapse = ",")

translation.description: Valid completions after ``@`` for an ``S4`` stand-in; other objects yield an empty list.

arguments.name: x
arguments.description: Object after ``@``; only ``utils.at_names.S4`` is treated as S4.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.description: Partial slot name, matched as a regular expression like R ``grep``.

translation.details: Uses the same default completion settings as R (exact match, no backticks).
translation.value: List of matching slot name strings.
translation.example:
from utils.at_names import AtNames, S4
obj = S4("TestS4AtNames", a=1, b="x")
print(",".join(AtNames(obj, "")))
